Translate AI makes understanding any language effortless. Powered by advanced AI, it helps you communicate, translate, and learn with ease.

Key Features:
● AI Translation – Translate text or documents with intelligent AI for fast and accurate results.
● Photo Translation – Snap a picture of text and get instant translations.
● Conversation Translation – Real-time, bilingual translation for smooth conversations during travel, meetings, or chatting with friends.
● Dictionary Lookup – Search words and see definitions, examples, and pronunciation instantly.

Premium Subscription:Unlock the full power of Translate AI with a subscription:
● Unlimited AI and photo translations
● Unlimited real-time conversation translations
● Full access to dictionary content
● Ad-free experience
Your subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment will be charged to your iTunes account. Manage or cancel anytime in Account Settings.
